Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit, no edits made):**  I traced the whole path — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` (cookie-based fetch) → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables — and, contrary to the ticket's working theory, I could **not find the hypothesized wiring bug**:  - Every watchlist route requires a valid session and scopes every query by `user_id` (no `?? 'guest'`, no default/anonymous fallback, no hardcoded IDs). - The client has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback
